payload.reason: The evidence describes a simpler preprocessing method introduced for labeling tweets related to the 2016 U.S. Presidential Election.

claims.text: The introduced preprocessing method involves removing URLs and pictures, while retaining hashtags, mentions, and retweets to maintain the original meaning of tweets.
This simpler preprocessing method achieves comparable performance to more complex methods used in previous studies.
The preprocessing method filters tweets to only include those containing candidates' names, removing 41% of the data.
